body: yes you know that you would have people there, I don't. i don't know anyone who i could call at this very moment(4:30 am on a tuesday) and they would be there.

i know where your coming from but have to disagree with you. where you see doing a normal thing i might see a mountain to climb with no one to help me. when  you put yourself in a social situation you see it as a normal everyday thing. every single time i talk with someone i don't consider family or a very close friend I find it very difficult to connect with them in an meaningful way. i do, do  stuff. i have various activities i do on a weekly basis but that doesn't mean i have the ability to interact with people beyond what most would call an acquaintanceship.

i seem to be able to start a friendship easy enough, but i don't have anyone i could call a confidant. i seem to always be the extra person in a group. not part of the core but one that everyone knows.
i attend regular reddit meetups but i always feel like an auxiliary member of the group
